title: Add the triage line, claim labels and evidence-first pushback to bee doctrine
action: Work in the worktree /mnt/data/Projects/goglbe/beehive--wt--verified-claims-triage. Turn the owner's v2 agent-work protocol into bee doctrine, using bee lane names (tiny, small, docs = fast lane; standard, high-risk = deep lane) and the existing route flags, never a PATH A/B or Tier vocabulary (decision 2eddf0e2). Contract: (1) packages/bee/LEADER.md gets ONE new rule block with marker pair <!-- rule: agents-verify-before-agreeing --> ... <!-- /rule --> placed in section 'Prove, then say so'. Bare rule, at most ~1100 bytes: (a) a task opens with one line 'Triage: <lane> — <reason in 10 words or fewer>' before its first tool call; a route flag never takes a fast lane; the user may override; a plain question needs no triage line (decision 3d666b0d). (b) each technical claim about code or behavior in a reply carries [verified] (read or ran in this session) or [unverified] (general knowledge or inference); never present [unverified] as fact. (c) never agree with a proposal until its key assumption is [verified]; the first reaction to an unchecked idea is conditional ('sounds right; checking X first'). (d) when the user's direction conflicts with the code, never say 'you are wrong': state the goal, what the code does and why with file:line, then the options. It points to the full forms by heading: routing-and-contracts.md ('Claim labels and pushback') and scout-and-ticks.md ('Fast-lane read budget'). (2) skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md, inside '## Communication contract', gets a subsection '### Claim labels and pushback' with the full form: label rules with one short example each; the conditional first reaction; the pushback shape as four parts Current state (file:line) / Gap / Options and trade-offs / Recommendation, with the plain-language opener 'I understand the goal is X. Current code does Y because Z (file:line). To keep X, the options are...'; and the Triage line form with one example per lane family. (3) skills/bee-hive/references/scout-and-ticks.md gets a subsection '### Fast-lane read budget' (under the Scout Contract): tiny/small read only the named file or line range plus AT MOST ONE exact-symbol search for the changed symbol's callers; broad or fuzzy searches and file-tree scans are out; a caller in another module or any route flag found means stop before patching, emit the line 'Escalating: <what was found>', and re-route upward with bee route --set (promotion is always available). Add the read order cheap to expensive: outline, symbol list, signatures first; then a line range; a whole file only before rewriting it. (4) docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md, section '## AGENTS.md rule homes', gets a row for agents-verify-before-agreeing in the same grammar as its siblings (home 'packages/bee/LEADER.md § Prove, then say so', an indented spoken: line ending in its reason after an em dash, and an applied_at list naming the two reference files). Write no code comments. Do not touch AGENTS.md, packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md or .bee/**. Do NOT run bee dev regen and do not touch docs/history/codex-harness-hardening/release-manifest.json; the leader runs the regen at merge.
